# Contributing to GOHIF

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the Global One Health Intelligence Framework (GOHIF).

GOHIF is an evidence-centric scientific research framework.

Contributions are expected to prioritize:

- Scientific rigor
- Reproducibility
- Transparency
- FAIR principles
- Provenance preservation

## Contribution Workflow

Scientific Discussion

↓

Critical Review

↓

Scientific Decision

↓

Coverage Analysis

↓

Freeze Decision

↓

Documentation Synchronization

↓

Git Commit

↓

Review

↓

Merge

No contribution should bypass scientific review.

## Dataset Contributions

New datasets must include:

- Scientific rationale
- Source organization
- Metadata assessment
- FAIR assessment
- Strengths
- Limitations
- Proposed evidence layer
- Proposed evidence class
- Supporting literature where applicable

## Documentation

Every accepted scientific change must update the appropriate master documents.

- MDI
- MRD
- MDD
- Decision Log
- README (when appropriate)
